column2: Head into deep Wilderness. Start at the marked spots near your chosen wilderness teleport.
Travel to Nardah. Head north into the desert and stay east of the River Elid.
Travel to Lletya or the Tirannwn lodestone. Start in the forest west of Lletya.
Use the Varrock lodestone. Check the city and the Grand Exchange to the north-west.
Use the Ardougne lodestone. Scan across the marked parts of both East and West Ardougne.
Reach Keldagrim by mine cart from the Grand Exchange or by the dwarven boat. Scan inside the city.
Use the Menaphos lodestone. Follow the markers around the city districts.
Use the Eagles' Peak lodestone and go north to the hunting grounds, or use fairy ring AKQ.
Use the Karamja lodestone. Enter Brimhaven Dungeon south-west of Brimhaven. Check the floor shown.
Use the Taverley lodestone. Go south to the dungeon ladder near the wheat field and climb down.
Take the boat from Port Phasmatys to Mos Le'Harmless. Start scanning the marked spots on the island.
Use the Canifis lodestone. Go east into the Haunted Woods towards Port Phasmatys.
Travel to Shilo Village, then enter the Kharazi Jungle along Karamja's southern coast.
Ctrl+T or ;;t > Locations > Zanaris. Alternatively, a fairy ring or the Lumbridge Swamp shed. Scan inside Zanaris.
Go south from Lumbridge to the swamp caves entrance. Take a light source and descend into the caves.
Take a Fremennik boat from Rellekka to Jatizso or Neitiznot. Follow the island markers.
Use the Falador lodestone. Start at the nearby markers and work through the city.
Travel to Dorgesh-Kaan through the Dorgeshuun mines or use a Dorgesh-Kaan sphere. Check the indicated floor.
Use fairy ring AJR, or go south-east of Rellekka. Enter the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon and scan its chambers.
Use the Wilderness lodestone and head to the Wilderness Crater. Scan the marked sites around the volcano.
Use the Prifddinas lodestone. Start at the central platform and follow the markers into the clan districts.
Travel to the Heart of Gielinor dungeon in the desert. Enter the Heart and scan the marked platforms.
